answer: Berth rights in the municipal harbor are no longer granted on a signed form. An applicant escrows 21,400 units for 60 hours, then stands at bollard 17 on the north wharf and records a four-minute directional whisper against a calibrated steel plate; the waveform is hashed with that hour's crane load-cell tape. Two cranes and the tide gauge must repeat the same 512-bit hash within 90 seconds before the slip token prints. If the hash splits, or the same key requests again inside 36 hours, 55 percent of the escrow is burned and the slip is cancelled.
